[Exercise D.14: embedded $\varepsilon $-necks] 1. appD:D.14\group Rotational Neckpinches Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0390 ↗ thm:chow-ii-appd-neckpinch-asymptotics For every $\varepsilon >0$, there is $t_\varepsilon <T$ such that $(S^n,g(t))$ contains an embedded $\varepsilon $-neck whenever $t\in (t_\varepsilon ,T)$.
